skin_words: teal scaled skin, its lighter highlights
face_tilt: a brow ridge that shades the eyes into two dark slits, and in front of it a blunt fish snout that juts forward to a wide mouth. Brow and snout sit close together, squeezed by the steep view, and the tip of the snout is the bottom edge of the head, with the chest starting directly below it. A fin-like ear sticks out sideways from each side of the head.
face_paint: the head as a scaled top of the skull seen from above with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural sahuagin face strongly foreshortened from above, a ridged brow over shadowed eyes and a blunt fish snout with a wide mouth
arms_paint: the shoulder band and the level arms covered in small overlapping scales over firm muscle
hands_paint: each hand with five webbed fingers
feet_tilt: At the very bottom the front halves of the two feet stand on the floor far below, toes pointing at the bottom of the picture, each a broad foot front with three long toes that fan out and end in claws.
feet_paint: each foot front with three long toes ending in short dark claws

crest.guide: A thin fin stands along the middle of the scalp from front to back.
crest.paint: the head fin as a thin ribbed membrane
